messages:
maria_support: FYI customer reported invoice shows ~4.3M tokens for March but their dashboard shows ~2.1M. They say spikes line up with a batch job that times out and retries.

tony_billing: thanks — can you attach the invoice id and a sample request id from the spike window?

maria_support: invoice INV-2026-0318-ACME, customer-provided request IDs: 0a1b2c3d 0a1b2c3e 0a1b2c3f (all same endpoint). They mentioned SDK v0.9.2.

ravi_infra: quick note — SDK v0.9.x didn't automatically set our x-idempotency-key header for streaming endpoints, right? older clients relied on server-side dedupe.

tony_billing: that could do it. If client retries without idempotency, gateway could replay and each successful write is metered. Any proxy logs?

maria_support: attaching logs from customer (redacted) and our ingress logs for the timeframe:

```
# ingress logs (trimmed)
2026-03-18T02:11:05Z client=10.2.44.5 req_id=0a1b2c3d status=200 tokens=1200
2026-03-18T02:11:12Z client=10.2.44.5 req_id=0a1b2c3d status=504 backend=timeout
2026-03-18T02:11:12Z client=10.2.44.5 req_id=0a1b2c3d status=200 tokens=1200
2026-03-18T02:11:13Z client=10.2.44.5 req_id=0a1b2c3e status=200 tokens=1300
2026-03-18T02:11:20Z client=10.2.44.5 req_id=0a1b2c3e status=502 backend=overloaded
2026-03-18T02:11:20Z client=10.2.44.5 req_id=0a1b2c3e status=200 tokens=1300
```

maria_support: looks like the gateway returned 504/502 then immediately a success for the same client request ids.

ravi_infra: that pattern is classic client-side retry combined with our LB health checks giving an early 5xx then a later success. We dedupe only when idempotency-key present. If SDK didn't set one, each success will be billed.

tony_billing: can we correlate the invoice token lines to these repeated successes? If yes, we'll need to credit the duplicate tokens for that window.

ravi_infra: running a quick query now to count duplicate req_id + user across that hour. If we see exact token repeats, we can flag duplicates. Also checking whether our metering pipeline collapsed retries into one event or kept all.

deploy-bot: meter-pipeline job 2026-03-18T03:00:00 started, shard-4 processing window 02:00-03:00 completed without fatal errors.

ravi_infra: query result (summary): user acme-corp had 4,312,000 tokens billed in hour 02:00-03:00; unique req_id token sum = 2,088,000; duplicates (same req_id seen >1 success) account for ~2,224,000 tokens.

tony_billing: that's convincing. Proposed remediation: issue a credit for ~2.22M tokens and update billing notes. We should also advise customer to upgrade SDK to v0.10+ which sets x-idempotency-key.

maria_support: agreed. I'll draft the customer reply and ask for their SDK config. Also propose we add a safe-guard: if we see exact repeated req_id from same client within 30s, mark as potential duplicate for manual review.

ravi_infra: caution — automated dedupe at the gateway layer is risky without solid idempotency semantics. But we can add an internal alert that surfaces high duplicate rates per account.

tony_billing: create a billing adjustment ticket and tag finance. Maria, please include the query output and ingress snippets.

maria_support: will do. Draft message to customer: "We found repeated successful deliveries for the same request ids during transient 5xx/504 events. Because the SDK did not send idempotency keys, each success was metered separately. We're issuing a credit for the duplicated tokens and recommend upgrading the SDK to v0.10+ or adding x-idempotency-key to your client. Sorry for the disruption."

ravi_infra: optional follow-up for platform: consider adding a gateway-side heuristic that looks for identical payload+user within short window and tags them. Not auto-crediting, but surface in console.

tony_billing: created FIN-ADJ-4312 for credit and attached evidence. Assigning to finance.

maria_support: closing loop after finance posts the credit and customer confirms SDK update. :thumbsup:
